description: This beautiful and fully remodeled single story home that perfectly blends modern elegance updates with natural charm is nestled in a highly desirable pocket of Tarzana just south of Ventura Boulevard near shopping, dining, recreation, and commuter routes, with access to highly regarded local schools.  Offering light filled expansive open floor plan with 3 bedrooms, 2.5 baths with 1884 square feet of living space on almost 6000 square feet lot.  Recessed lighting, engineered wood flooring, office with built in work station and library with glass paneled iron door.  This fully renovated designer kitchen is crisp and modern with white quartz countertops, generous custom made sleek cabinetry with Emtek handles and top of the line stainless-steel appliances.   Very conveniently located laundry room in the hallway with stackable washer and dryer and storage area. Living room with high ceiling, French doors that lead to manicured backyard. The seamless indoor-outdoor flow creates an inviting setting for entertaining and everyday living. The spacious primary bedroom offers privacy with wall to wall closet an ensuite bath, oversized tiled shower, and dual shower heads double sink and another oversized walk-in closet.  Sliding glass door that opens to the beautiful backyard.  Second bedroom has walk in closet and half a bath.  Tandem 2 car carport.  220 Volt EV outlet in the carport.  Truly a pride of ownership.
